- **The export Marc pointed at is real and does show OPEN** — `status-mgmt/INC-881-export.json`, `status_page_state: "OPEN"`, `exported_at: 2026-07-24T09:55:00Z`, customer-facing "Some customers may see elevated errors on checkout. - **But the export is a 4-day-old snapshot taken ~25 min after declaration** — before the rollback completed and before @omar confirmed "error rate is back to baseline" at 09:30Z. That's the team-facing status of record per `README.md` and `status/status-publishing.md`.
